name: Play! Play! Play! Shi
original_name: プレイ！プレイ！プレイ！屍
source:
Kuro Okajima was born with a congenital heart disease.
He won't live to be twenty years old, and he doesn't want to die
with any regrets. That is to say, he won't miss out on love.
But when he asks his childhood friend to go steady, she rejects him!
The young man with the fragile heart is heartbroken too soon!

He laughs miserably, "I see, I see. OF COURSE!
Nobody wants to be with a weak-hearted virgin slated for death.
I can't even get laid. It's like I'm dead already!"

Kuro's frustration warps him from a caring soul... into... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE155653.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
冈岛黑一出生就患有先天性心脏病。
他活不过二十岁，他也不想死
带着任何遗憾。也就是说，他不会错过爱情。
但当他要求他的儿时好友稳定一点时，她却拒绝了他！
内心脆弱的年轻人，伤心得太早了！

他苦笑道：“我明白了，我明白了，当然了！
没有人愿意和一个注定要死的、内心脆弱的处女在一起。
我什至无法上床。就好像我已经死了一样！”

库洛的挫败感使他从一个充满关怀的灵魂……变成了…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE155653.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
